name: obsidian-editor-uxfix
description: Long-press a line to fold or unfold it (its parent if it has no children); click where the caret is to toggle the line; Alt+wheel (or wheel while holding the right button, on Windows) folds or unfolds the whole document one level at a time, keeping the line under the mouse in place; the wheel left of the text (margin, indentation, list markers, heading #) steps just the range that spot belongs to; header buttons do the same
author: Hyunyoung Park
